meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在集群上扩展 pandas 与 NumPy 的数据处理能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 pandas 代码因数据过大而内存溢出
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas and NumPy workflows across clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pandas code runs out of memory with large datasets

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Dask 库帮你处理超出电脑内存的大型表格或数据。它会把大任务拆成小块并行计算,也能跨多台电脑运行,并遵循官方的性能建议。
howto.when: 当你需要处理的数据量超过电脑内存,或想把 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到集群上运行时触发。也适用于并行处理多个文件等场景。

say.text: 帮我用 Dask 读取这个文件夹里的所有 CSV,并计算每组的平均值。
say.note: Claude 会用 Dask 并行读取并合并计算。

say.text: 我的数据有 50GB,内存不够,用 Dask 帮我做分组统计。
say.note: Claude 会写适合超内存数据的 Dask 代码。

say.text: 用 Dask 把这个 pandas 程序改成能跨集群运行的版本。
say.note: Claude 会给出分布式改造方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses Dask to process tables or files larger than your computer's memory. It splits big tasks into chunks for parallel computing, can run on multiple machines, and follows official performance advice.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to process data larger than your computer's memory, or want to scale existing pandas/NumPy code to a cluster. Also used for parallel file processing and similar scenarios.

say_en.text: Use Dask to read all CSVs in this folder and compute the mean per group.
say_en.note: Claude will read and compute in parallel with Dask.

say_en.text: My data is 50GB and won't fit in memory; use Dask for group-by statistics.
say_en.note: Claude will write Dask code for out-of-memory data.

say_en.text: Use Dask to turn this pandas script into a cluster-ready version.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest a distributed redesign.
